data.one_liner: A time and date solution replacing core DateTime with advanced arithmetic and time zone support.
data.what_it_does: Tempo replaces Dart's core DateTime with a rich set of date and time classes. It offers advanced arithmetic features like human-like month/year addition and full time zone support.
use_when: You need robust time zone handling and conversions.
You want advanced date/time arithmetic that handles months and leap years correctly.
avoid_when: You only need basic, native DateTime operations without additional dependencies.
strengths: Comprehensive time zone support with TZDB updates.
weaknesses: Introduces a new custom date/time API instead of using core types.
